theme.style: Clean modern SaaS interface, minimal and professional with high information density
theme.accent_gradients: Strictly limited to subtle blue ambient glow or crisp solid borders

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900
hierarchy.h2_section: text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900

layout_and_navigation.structure: Sidebar + Header + Scrollable Content Area + Command Palette (Cmd+K) + Global Slide-Over Panel

sidebar.type: Collapsible responsive rail with search, organization selector, main nav sections, quick add menu, and user settings

grid_modes.dashboard_bento: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6 align-start
grid_modes.kanban_board: flex overflow-x-auto gap-4 p-2 min-h-[600px] snap-x
grid_modes.table_view: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm shadow-slate-100

component_strategies.tables: Sticky table header, batch selection checkboxes, quick search input, column filter dropdowns, row click slide-over drawer, pagination, export options
component_strategies.kanban: Drag and drop column stages with stage total values, lead count indicators, card priority badges, quick deal creation
component_strategies.forms: Floating labelless or crisp-labeled inputs with subtext validation, Shadcn Select / Popover / DatePicker primitives
component_strategies.charts: Recharts AreaChart / BarChart with soft gradient fills, clean tooltip cards, legend toggles
component_strategies.ai_assistant: Interactive slide-over or dedicated tab assistant with predefined prompt chips (e.g. 'Summarize overdue deals', 'Draft follow-up email', 'Predict pipeline forecast')

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based, e.g., data-testid='nav-leads-link', data-testid='dashboard-kpi-revenue', data-testid='lead-stage-kanban-board', data-testid='create-deal-button'
testing_and_accessibility.wcag: Contrast ratio minimum 4.5:1 for standard text, 3:1 for large headers and icons. All interactive controls support keyboard focus states.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-grade, highly functional, and fully responsive generic CRM SaaS dashboard.

Ensure all 24 specified navigation tabs (Dashboard, Leads, Pipeline, Contacts, Companies, Deals, Clients, Projects, Tasks, Proposals, Contracts, Invoices, Payments, Website Connections, Forms, Website Leads, Analytics, Marketing, Campaigns, Content, Communication, Reports, AI Assistant, Settings) are functional and well-structured.
Implement Organization Branding customization in Settings so users can change Org Name, Primary Accent Color, and Logo.
Include a global Command Search bar (Cmd+K / Ctrl+K), Quick Actions modal, and AI Assistant feature.
Make sure every interactive element includes a valid data-testid attribute for stable testing.
